newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen rebounding after flood-fall.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen rebounding after flood-fall.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to rebound on Wednesday after a three-session fall deepened by concerns on the current flooding in southern Poland.
Analysts said however that continued flood worries as well as concern on the falling zloty could make growth short-lived.
Gorazdze resumes trade on Wednesday after a two-day suspension on Tuesday's news the flood had caused it no damage. Polifarb Wroclaw, Rafako, ZEW and Viscoplast remain suspended.
Celuloza, ComputerLand, Elektrobubowa, Forte and Relpol start continuous trade on Wednesday.
